# Milestone 4d, the import lists: the IMDb watchlist the maintainer uses
# (`IMDbListImport`), its settings written and tested, the sync that adds
# the movies it names, and what an exclusion and a deletion do to the
# next one. A recording of its own, next to golden-library's; same format,
# and signalr.json holds what the hub sent after each step.
#
#   GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-list/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-list make golden-radarr
#
# The watchlist itself is served by scripts/mock-servarr.py from the
# hand-made tests/fixtures/metadata/api.radarr.video/v1/list/imdb/
# ur0000001.json, which names four movies: one the library has (Alien:
# Romulus), one the lists exclude (Titane) and two it adds (The Prestige,
# Gravity).
config-host GET /api/v3/config/host
config-host-put-proxy PUT /api/v3/config/host/1 bodies/config-host-proxy.json
sleep 8
config-importlist GET /api/v3/config/importlist

# The list as the fixture holds it, the schema the UI builds its form
# from, and the settings written: the watchlist the mock serves.
importlist GET /api/v3/importlist
importlist-schema GET /api/v3/importlist/schema
importlist-1 GET /api/v3/importlist/1
importlist-put PUT /api/v3/importlist/1 bodies/importlist-put.json
importlist-after-put GET /api/v3/importlist/1

# What the settings refuse: a list id of neither shape, an empty one, a
# root folder that is not there, a profile that is not there, a name
# already taken, and the `ls12345678` lists the original dropped.
importlist-put-bad-id PUT /api/v3/importlist/1 bodies/importlist-put-bad-id.json
importlist-put-empty-id PUT /api/v3/importlist/1 bodies/importlist-put-empty-id.json
importlist-put-bad-root PUT /api/v3/importlist/1 bodies/importlist-put-bad-root.json
importlist-put-bad-profile PUT /api/v3/importlist/1 bodies/importlist-put-bad-profile.json
importlist-create POST /api/v3/importlist bodies/importlist-create.json
importlist-create-taken POST /api/v3/importlist bodies/importlist-create-taken.json
importlist-create-no-name POST /api/v3/importlist bodies/importlist-create-no-name.json
importlist-after-create GET /api/v3/importlist

# The tests the UI runs: the watchlist answers, one nobody has does not,
# and `testall` runs both lists.
importlist-test POST /api/v3/importlist/test bodies/importlist-test.json
importlist-test-missing POST /api/v3/importlist/test bodies/importlist-test-missing.json
importlist-test-ls POST /api/v3/importlist/test bodies/importlist-test-ls.json
importlist-testall POST /api/v3/importlist/testall
importlist-after-test GET /api/v3/importlist

# The sync of one list by id, then of every list. The movies the
# watchlist names and the library lacks are added, monitored and searched
# for as the list asks; the one the library has and the one the lists
# exclude are not.
command-importlistsync-one POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-importlistsync-one.json
sleep 20
command-after-sync-one GET /api/v3/command
movie-prestige GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=1124
movie-gravity GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=49047
movie-titane GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=630240
importlist-movie GET /api/v3/importlist/movie
history-after-sync GET /api/v3/history?page=1&pageSize=10&sortKey=date&sortDirection=descending
health-after-sync GET /api/v3/health

# A movie deleted with an exclusion does not come back: the next sync
# rejects it, and the sync of a list that is not there is an error.
movie-delete-excluded DELETE /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-prestige}?deleteFiles=false&addImportExclusion=true
exclusions-after-delete GET /api/v3/exclusions
command-importlistsync POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-importlistsync.json
sleep 20
command-after-sync GET /api/v3/command
movie-prestige-after GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=1124
movie-after-sync GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=49047
command-importlistsync-missing POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-importlistsync-missing.json
sleep 6
command-after-sync-missing GET /api/v3/command

# The second list removed, and the first disabled: the lists as they are
# then, and the health checks a list raises.
importlist-delete DELETE /api/v3/importlist/{id:importlist-create}
importlist-delete-missing DELETE /api/v3/importlist/999
importlist-put-disabled PUT /api/v3/importlist/1 bodies/importlist-put-disabled.json
importlist-after GET /api/v3/importlist
importlist-movie-after GET /api/v3/importlist/movie
health-after-list GET /api/v3/health
